definition_of_ready: user journey and desired outcome known
no unresolved product choice materially changes implementation
definition_of_done: isolated branch integrated with explicit scope
preview verified with synthetic data and authored states
fresh live read-back proves exact deployed behavior

operating_objective_gate.question: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
operating_objective_gate.pass_rule: For each routine selected for cutover, Joe completes and explains the routine without a heavy AI session, with no loss of authority, evidence, or recovery behavior. Dell may independently complete the same routine, but his participation does not gate cutover.
operating_objective_gate.failure_action: Keep the prior surface available, record the missing product capability, and route only the genuinely complex portion to an engineering request.
operating_objective_gate.does_not_mean: Eliminate Claude Code or Codex for exploration, genuinely complex investigation, or new construction.

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Joe’s current weekly time spent using heavy AI sessions for routine system/business operation
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: time diary plus interview; value remains unknown until observed
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Prioritize the highest-time routine for a visual workflow, Doc answer, or governed action card
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like weekly minutes at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Count and categories of routine questions that require Claude/Codex explanation
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: classify observed questions and interview recall; do not invent counts
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Add grounded visual explanation, source/freshness context, or Doc retrieval for repeated categories
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare count and category mix at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Count and categories of recurring actions that cannot be completed visually
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: journey inventory and partner interview; do not infer frequency
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Create a straightforward governed control or intentionally classify the action as heavy engineering work
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Re-run the same journey inventory after launch

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Median time to determine business state and system health
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: timed uncoached tasks across representative days; no synthetic measured value
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Refine Command Center summaries, source links, freshness, and Control Room safe status until the delay cause is removed
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Repeat the same timed tasks at 30 and 90 days

baseline_measure_plan.measure: Number of hand-carried context transfers between sessions
baseline_measure_plan.baseline_method: count observed manual copy/relay events and interview examples; value remains unknown until measured
baseline_measure_plan.bound_product_action: Add durable request context, task-to-task handoff, origin links, and returned evidence
baseline_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like hand-carried transfers at 30 and 90 days

configuration_allow_list: retention choices inside owner policy bounds
seat-safe display identity and notification preferences
tenant_boundary_acceptance.pass_rule: Every runtime channel proves exact server-derived tenant isolation and payload-free attributed denial; a static fixture alone never counts as production enforcement.

agent attribution and sponsoring human both survive audit

sponsor_runtime_identity_acceptance.current_gate_status: passed_live_and_deterministic_matrix: the identity repair was verified at 144 shared plus 30 Joe-personal; the council-packet preflight on 2026-08-12 returned 146 shared plus 31 Joe-personal with distinct server-derived tenant, sponsor, runtime, brain scope, and capability metadata; caller-selected partner was refused; counts are dated evidence; Dell, Claude, future registered agent, unsponsored, missing-scope, audit, and non-escalation cases passed deterministic safe tests
sponsor_runtime_identity_acceptance.pass_rule: The current gate passes on live Joe-sponsored connector evidence plus deterministic safe identity-matrix evidence and generated-render parity. Reopen on missing scope reported as success, a correct total with the wrong brain, caller-selected sponsor or tenant, cross-brain disclosure, capability inheritance, or connector/render drift.
sponsor_runtime_identity_acceptance.failure_action: Fail visibly before personal-rule use, preserve runtime-agent attribution, deny humanOnly and cross-brain access, and keep Phase 0 identity incomplete.

five_business_day_trial.scope: one named tenant, workflow, immutable version, partner cohort, record allow-list, and rollback owner
pass: consequential effects exactly approved and read back
routine passes the AI-session displacement test
five_business_day_trial.failure: hold or roll back and create a new immutable version; calendar passage never promotes a workflow

workflow_lifecycle_acceptance.future_runtime_evidence: Promotion, rollback, cutover, running-work version pinning, and retirement are future staging and production gates.

maintenance_measure_plan.baseline_method: time diary, attributed work-request classification, and Joe interview; no observed value until evidence exists
maintenance_measure_plan.exception_rule: material new scope, vendor/platform incidents, security/privacy events, data repair/migration, council redesign, owner investigation, and legal/compliance change are attributed separately
maintenance_measure_plan.escalation_gate: More than five normal internal maintenance hours in each of two consecutive months creates prioritized toil-reduction work.
maintenance_measure_plan.low_toil_mature_claim_gate: A low-toil or mature claim requires three complete consecutive normal months at three to five human hours, with required control evidence intact and exceptions reported separately.
maintenance_measure_plan.bound_product_action: When the two-consecutive-month escalation gate fires, create prioritized toil-reduction work for the repeated toil.
maintenance_measure_plan.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like rolling monthly normal internal hours and separately reported exceptions at 30, 60, and 90 days; do not claim low-toil or mature before the three-complete-consecutive-month gate passes.

owner_control_acceptance.customer_boundary: Corporate may license owner-controlled seats only as a customer and receives no platform, intellectual-property, source, infrastructure, security-policy, or roadmap control.
owner_control_acceptance.launch_surface_rule: No public signup, billing, tenant administration, ownership-transfer, generic workflow engine, plugin marketplace, customer scripting, or customer workflow-authoring surface exists.
